headline_marked: Valve threatens legal action over [[Portal 2 Companion Cube case]] sold by Dbrand
headline: Valve threatens legal action over Portal 2 Companion Cube case sold by Dbrand
summary: Dbrand sold unauthorized Portal 2 Companion Cube case, now refunding orders
details: Valve's legal team reached out to Dbrand and asked it to shut down the entire operation; halt sales immediately and take down the sales page and all promotional content.
Dbrand complied and even extended a hand for an official collaboration, but Valve turned down the offer.
The popular skin manufacturer has previously found itself in similar hot waters with Sony and Nintendo.
caption:
Valve cracks down on unauthorized Portal 2 merchandise

Valve's legal team reached out to Dbrand and asked it to shut down the entire operation; halt sales immediately and take down the sales page and all promotional content.

Dbrand complied and even extended a hand for an official collaboration, but Valve turned down the offer.

The popular skin manufacturer has previously found itself in similar hot waters with Sony and Nintendo.

headline_marked: Google [[working on Pixel wallpaper shuffle]] feature
headline: Google working on Pixel wallpaper shuffle feature
summary: Shuffle your Pixel wallpapers like on iPhone
details: Google is developing a shuffle feature for Pixel wallpapers, similar to iPhone's Photo Shuffle. This feature, spotted in Android 17 QPR1 beta 5, allows users to create an album of favorite people and pets to auto-refresh their wallpaper.

The feature, called 'Shuffle Your Wallpaper,' enables users to select albums, such as travel photos or favorite quotes, to rotate their wallpapers. The auto-refresh can be set to hourly, daily, sunrise, sunset, or 'on tap.'

For those who want to try wallpaper shuffling sooner, Google offers 'Collections by Google' in the Wallpaper & style settings, which includes categories like Cityscapes, art from Google Arts & Culture, and more. Third-party apps like Wallpaper Changer on the Play Store also offer similar functionality.
